model.expr: (sum(rate(buildit_failures_total{buildit_outcome="failed"}[10m])) or vector(0)) / clamp_min((sum(rate(buildit_operations_total{buildit_outcome=~"succeeded|failed"}[10m])) or vector(0)), 0.001) > 0.05 and (sum(increase(buildit_operations_total{buildit_outcome=~"succeeded|failed"}[10m])) or vector(0)) >= 20

annotations.action: Check the BuildIT failure and latency panels, then pause the failing boundary if the ratio is still rising.
annotations.summary: More than 5% of BuildIT operations are failing

annotations.action: Compare provider, runner, and queue latency; reduce intake if the slow boundary is saturated.
annotations.summary: BuildIT operation p95 is above two minutes

annotations.action: Check the Convex cron ran, then the collector delivery path and the most recent deployment. An idle product is not this alert - the snapshot emits whether or not anyone is reviewing.
annotations.summary: No BuildIT telemetry has arrived for three snapshot intervals

annotations.action: Stop the affected execution path, confirm cleanup and deletion, then follow the incident runbook before resuming.
annotations.summary: A BuildIT security or safety boundary failed

annotations.action: Check worker capacity and provider limits; stop new intake if wait time continues to grow.
annotations.summary: BuildIT review queue has stayed above 25

annotations.action: Check provider status and bounded retry counts; disable the failing provider route if errors continue.
annotations.summary: A review ended without a verdict because a provider would not answer

annotations.action: No review has failed yet. Check provider status pages and error codes before the retries stop absorbing it.
annotations.summary: BuildIT is retrying provider calls more than usual

annotations.action: Disable untrusted execution, confirm every sandbox stopped, and inspect runner capacity before resuming.
annotations.summary: BuildIT runner execution or cleanup failed

annotations.action: Upgrade the Vercel sandbox plan or wait for the reset date. Reviews will return inconclusive until then, which is correct - they are not claiming to have checked anything.
annotations.summary: BuildIT cannot run checks: the sandbox plan's usage is spent

annotations.action: Pause new artifact creation, run the deletion reconciler, and confirm the backlog returns to zero.
Check GitHub delivery status and secret rotation history; keep rejected requests blocked.
annotations.summary: BuildIT is rejecting an unusual number of webhook signatures

annotations.action: Confirm the run stopped at its configured bound and no further candidate or merge action occurred.
annotations.summary: A BuildIT Autofix loop safety bound stopped a run

annotations.action: Confirm the stale run made no write and let the user start a new review at the current commit.
annotations.summary: BuildIT stopped because the reviewed commit changed

annotations.action: Check model routing and context size; do not raise customer ceilings automatically.
annotations.summary: More than three BuildIT reviews exhausted their budget this hour
